answer: Kidston: closure year 2001 is the latest End Year in the MINOCC 2017 MineHist table for this site (MINOCC-2017:MineHist:479629:3): the last recorded period of working ended then, which says when working last ended, not why. Gold in 2001 averaged US$270.83/oz nominal (mean of the World Bank Pink Sheet monthly averages for the year; 12 months; A$528.76 nominal). In 2026-10 US dollars that is US$516.24/oz (US CPI-U, 2001 average 177.067 against 337.511). Gold in 2026-10 averaged US$4105/oz, 7.95 times the closure-year price in today's dollars. US-dollar purchasing power (US CPI-U); not an Australian-dollar figure. CPI snapshot taken 2026-11-21.
